title: The Cramer-Wold theorem
abstract: Formalizes the finite-dimensional Cramer-Wold theorem for measures on Euclidean spaces, with Banach-space continuous-dual generalizations, Hilbert-space inner-product versions, and random-variable law corollaries for identical distributions and `HasLaw`.

informal.LeanPool.CramerWold.euclideanSpace_measu: Proves the classical finite-dimensional Cramer-Wold theorem for finite Borel measures on `EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)`, showing equality when all scalar projections have equal pushforward measures.
informal.LeanPool.CramerWold.measure_eq_of_forall: Generalizes the extensionality criterion to finite Borel measures on complete second-countable real normed spaces, using all continuous-linear real projections.
Specializes Cramer-Wold extensionality to real Hilbert spaces, using scalar projections of the form `x ↦ ⟪t, x⟫_ℝ`.
informal.LeanPool.CramerWold.identDistrib_of_fora: Proves that two finite-measure random variables are identically distributed when every continuous-linear real projection of them is identically distributed.
Gives the Hilbert-space random-variable version using all scalar inner-product projections.
informal.LeanPool.CramerWold.hasLaw_of_forall_dua: Proves that a random variable has a target law when every continuous-linear real projection has the corresponding projected target law.
